senses.gloss: , constr. of חַמָּה heat of; מֵחַ׳ through the heat of, from the effect of, in consequence of.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 6:3">B. Mets. VI, 3</cite> <he>מח׳ המעלה</he> overcome by heat through the exertion of climbing up the ascent.
<cite ref="Chullin 4b:5">Ḥull. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>מתו אחיו מח׳ מילה</he> his brothers had died in consequence of the circumcision.

<cite ref="Niddah 36b:48">Nidd. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>מח׳ עצמה</he> spontaneously; <he>מח׳ ולד</he> in consequence of travailing; <he>מח׳ אונס</he> from an accidental cause; a. fr.—(Also in Chald. phraseology) Targ. II, <cite ref="Esther 7:9">Esth. VII, 9</cite> <he>מחמת ד־</he> (ed. Lag. <he>מהֵימַת</he>) because they take &c.—
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 114a:4">B. Kam. 114ᵃ</cite> <he>כל אונסא דאתי מֵחַמְתֵיה</he> any injury that may arise from his action (of selling).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 15a">Ab. Zar. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>אזל מחמתיה</he> (the animal) moves at his instance; a. fr.
